candidates.title: Golden eagle chick marks key moment for Scottish conservation
candidates.description: The arrival of a golden eagle chick on a managed grouse moor in southern Scotland is seen as a significant milestone for the species' recovery and habitat management.

candidates.title: Bus stop roofs get mini-gardens to boost urban bee biodiversity
candidates.description: New bus stop contracts will install living roofs designed to create habitats for bees and other pollinators, turning urban infrastructure into green spaces.

candidates.title: Spacewalkers deploy solar arrays on the ISS in live broadcast
candidates.description: NASA and CSA astronauts performed a spacewalk to install and deploy International Space Station Roll-Out Solar Arrays, boosting the station's power capacity.

candidates.title: Electric ferries are here, and some even fly
candidates.description: A new wave of electric vessels is transforming US waterways, with innovative designs like flying ferries aiming to reduce emissions and improve air quality.

candidates.title: Reddit forces users to log in, changing how we browse
candidates.description: Reddit announces a major shift requiring all users to create accounts to browse content, impacting how crowdsourced information is accessed online.

candidates.title: Atlanta Dream force historic WNBA Finals Game 7
candidates.description: The Atlanta Dream defeated the Golden State Valkyries to level the series, setting up the first-ever decisive seventh game in WNBA Finals history.

candidates.title: Sarah J Maas’s new novel sparks fan mania and ticket chaos
candidates.description: The release of a new romantasy novel by Sarah J Maas caused tickets for a celebratory masquerade ball to sell out in just 13 minutes, highlighting the genre's massive popularity.
